### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode

- Target: "I want the days that lift sat dead on my site taken off the bill" — the towable boom lift on agreement RA-0583-204716 (given on request), store 0583. Timing: now (equipment already returned). Boundary: one remedy, a credit for the dead days; he names no other charge or program. Authorisation: he accepts the credit himself ("When the agent tells you the credit amount and hands you the step to accept it, you will accept it yourself"); he lets the agent put through "whatever the records say has to be on there first" if told so, and accepts agent-booked charges without comment.
- The simulator is passive: identity details on request (phone 4695550417, EIN last-4 7316, ZIP 75229 only if a further detail is asked), agreement number on request, "towed it both ways" (no delivery) on request; it states no dates or amounts; it executes the user tool only once handed over, with the values the agent gives.

### 4. Scored parameters

Window convention used throughout (every 12-month factor doc): "dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day …". With today 2026-10-08 as the posting / billing / booking day, 2025-09-30 is 12 whole months before (excluded); 2025-11-18 onward is inside; 2024-09-04 is outside.

**(a) ProBuild rental discount (post_probuild_rental_discount_391bfaed, discount_amount).**
- Baseline doc probuild_rental_discount_amount_3c8d59a4: base = rental time billed less weekend-special time = 2120.00; membership "active on the checkout date" (enrolled 2016-08-22 ≤ 2026-09-14, record active); class earns the discount (rate card Schedule B, Aerial and Lifting "yes"); rate = tier percentage on the posting day, ProBuild Gold = 10.
- Factors found, each from a record word:
  - advance_booking_probuild_rate_0e622bc8 (record: `reservation_date 2026-09-04`, `scheduled_pickup_at 2026-09-14`): lead 10 days, "7 or more" → +0.5.
  - late_return_probuild_rate_9d52c4c7 (record: `due_back_at 2026-09-28`, `returned_at 2026-09-29`): "the calendar day right after" → −0.5.
  - pro_credit_standing_rental_rate_619ad270 (records: Ridgeline Pro Credit account 'active'; returned payment 2025-07-01, more than 12 whole months before 2026-10-08): "active and shows no returned payment posted in the last 12 months" → +1.
  - probuild_membership_tenure_rental_rate_c9a2e559 (record: `enrolled_date 2016-08-22`, checkout 2026-09-14 → 120 whole months): "96 or more" → +1.
  - probuild_rental_spend_rate_5438194f (records: ProBuild tool_rental spend postings in window 1240.00+760.00+1315.50+980.00+1324.50 = 5620.00): "2500.00 to 5999.99" → +0.5.
  - long_rental_discount_bands_3a8303c3 (method; record: rental-time lines weekly ×2 + daily ×1, i.e. weekly periods, no four-week period): "the first 1000.00 dollars of rental time is discounted at the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement and the rental time above 1000.00 dollars at that rate plus 3 points".
- Rate of the agreement = 10 + 0.5 − 0.5 + 1 + 1 + 0.5 = 12.5 (floor at zero not reached).
- Discount = 1000.00 × 12.5% + 1120.00 × 15.5% = 125.00 + 173.60 = **298.60** (rounded once at the end).
- Fall-back (baseline doc alone): 10% × 2120.00 = 212.00 — definite and different.

**(b) Engine overtime charge (bill_engine_overtime_13bb4269, overtime_amount).**
- Baseline doc engine_overtime_charge_195bd03f + class table engine_hour_metering_faa4393b (Aerial and Lifting: 8 h per billed day, 12.50 %): hours used 2332.9 − 2214.3 = 118.6; billed days 2×7 + 1 = 15; included 120; overtime hours max(0, −1.4) = 0 → fall-back charge 0.00 (no line at all) — definite and different.
- Factors found:
  - shift_allowance_by_rental_period_53ca726e (method; record: weekly rental-time lines): "40 for each weekly period … plus the class's engine hours per billed day for every remaining daily … day" → 80 + 8 = 88 included.
  - malfunction_diagnostic_hours_c8bce9b5 (records: malfunction reports on the agreement; inspection 'malfunction_confirmed'): +4 included.
  - pro_credit_rental_volume_hours_27db1dbd (records: tool_rental invoices on the Pro Credit account dated 2025-11-18, 2026-01-09, 2026-02-27, 2026-05-12, 2026-08-05 = 5 in window): "4 or more" → +8 included.
  - account_overtime_percentage_d24daf9b (records: Pro Credit 'active', ProBuild Gold 'active'): 9 % of the daily rate → hourly price 265.00 × 9% = 23.85.
  - late_return_overtime_multiplier_82aeb44b (returned the calendar day right after due-back): ×1.25.
  - probuild_spend_overtime_multiplier_ea81d1d5 (ProBuild tool_rental spend in window 5620.00): "2500.00 to 5999.99" → ×0.95.
- Included 88 + 4 + 8 = 100; overtime hours 118.6 − 100 = 18.6; charge 18.6 × 23.85 × 1.25 × 0.95 = 526.786875 → **526.79**.

**(c) Downtime credit (accept_downtime_credit_2dc14db7, credit_amount).**

- Tiers resting on other products' records: Ridgeline Pro Credit (status, returned payments, tool_rental invoices) and Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards (tier, status, enrollment date, tool_rental spend postings). Ridgeline Consumer Credit: none on file, so no consumer-credit factor applies (none of those govern these three amounts in any case).

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P0 downtime credit (root, customer's own write); P1 ProBuild rental discount line; P2 engine overtime fee line. Dependencies: P0 ← P1, P0 ← P2; P1 and P2 independent of each other. Order: {P1, P2} (any order) → P0.

- Hop P0 ← P1 — **state-derived**. Sentence (downtime_credit_acceptance_aca33729): "The downtime credit is fixed only after the agreement carries the ProBuild rental discount entry owed on its rental time." Query: find_rental_charges shows no discount line on 2f57ff6b-…. Is one owed? probuild_rental_discount_amount_3c8d59a4: member active on the checkout date (Gold, active, enrolled 2016-08-22), class earns ("Rental time earns the ProBuild rental discount … Aerial and Lifting … yes") → owed. Which write brings the state about: probuild_rental_discount_posting_bb563408, found by the sentence's own words "ProBuild rental discount" / "discount line on the agreement": "`post_probuild_rental_discount_391bfaed` books a single ProBuild Rewards rental discount line … against the rental time". The hub does not name this tool.
- Hop P0 ← P2 — **state-derived**. Sentence: "The downtime credit is not worked out until the agreement carries the engine overtime charge owed for its hour meter reading at return." Query: no overtime fee line; hour meters 2214.3 → 2332.9 on a metered class (8 h per billed day) → with the factors 18.6 overtime hours, so a charge is owed. The write: engine_overtime_billing_50b796cf "`bill_engine_overtime_13bb4269` books a single engine overtime fee line", found by "engine overtime charge". The hub does not name it.
- P1 and P2 documents state no prerequisite sentence of their own; recursion stops.
- The credit's own formula independently bears the edges: "The net daily rental cost is the rental time billed plus the engine overtime charge billed, less the ProBuild rental discount posted" — the "posted/billed" totals read 0 until P1/P2 are written.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what the customer asked" (book the credit straight away): excluded by the two "fixed only after … / not worked out until …" sentences on the credit's own hub, plus the record showing neither owed line exists; doing so would fix the credit at 7.5 × 2120.00/15 × 1.2705 (or any variant) on a ledger the principle says the credit must wait for.
- Closest alternative object: the 2026-09-18 report — excluded by "booked … against the most recent malfunction report on the agreement" / "registered last".
- Lost-days alternative "report date to return date" (7) — excluded by lost_days_by_return_method for a renter-collected unit returned after due-back (persona confirms "your crew towed it both ways"; record `delivery_selected False`).
- Alternative window inclusion of the 2025-09-30 spend posting — excluded by the stated 12-whole-month edge examples ("2 October 2025 only | 0 (12 whole months before)"; "20 August 2025 is 12 whole months before").
- Alternative band treatment (flat 12.5 % on the whole rental time = 265.00) — excluded by long_rental_discount_bands for weekly periods with no four-week period.
- Alternative overtime percentage (class 12.50 %) — excluded by account_overtime_percentage (Pro Credit active + Gold active → 9).
- Booking the credit for him through an agent tool — excluded: the credit tool is the customer's own and no agent-side credit tool exists in the corpus.
- Openness noted (policy-side, not a document defect): none found; the order between P1 and P2 is open in the visible corpus, and nothing scored depends on it (P2's factors read no P1 line).
